marketing_description: The DeWALT DCLE34520GB Cordless 5-Spot Green Line Laser features a cross-line laser with 5 spot points for layout versatility, a green beam for enhanced visibility over long distances, and an over-molded housing with IP54 rating for jobsite durability. It includes an integrated magnetic bracket for easy attachment to metal surfaces and offers a working range of 330 ft with the detector and 280 ft without. This laser is powered by a 20 V battery and features self-leveling with a leveling range of +/- 4 deg.
